title: Static portfolio content pipeline
subtitle: Typed build-time content system
home_summary: Generated typed portfolio content from spreadsheet-compatible CSV files.
detail_summary: A static-first content pipeline that normalizes CSV rows into typed JSON for a portfolio site.
problem: Portfolio content often becomes hard-coded and difficult to update.
solution: Use public CSV exports at build time and render static pages from generated JSON.
impact: Keeps deployment simple while making content updates spreadsheet-driven.
